repositories.primary_anchor: DeskPilot is a desktop agent product that executes user-approved tasks through a local graphical workspace.
repositories.product_outcome_anchor:
The application lets a person review a proposed action, approve it, and inspect
the resulting files in one desktop session. Its primary output is the running
workspace and its task history.

repositories.incidental_region_end_anchor: The sample prompts and miniature tool registry are incidental documentation for DeskPilot; they are not an independently maintained catalog or reusable resource collection.

repositories.primary_anchor: Field Guide is a maintained curated catalog of independently useful agent tools and implementation references.
repositories.catalog_outcome_anchor:
Every entry has a concise use case, maintenance note, license pointer, and link
to its original source. Entries are reviewed before inclusion and stale links
are removed during scheduled catalog maintenance.

repositories.low_value_anchor:

intended audience.
